Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - CC/903/2021

Dear Ms. Gaikwad,

Thank you for meeting us on 9 December 2021 about your dispute with Sameer Pandey. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Hyderabad.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 12,10,000.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Hyderabad
